# Videngine

> Videngine is a programmatic video engine built and run by Wall & Fifth Ltd. It turns a web page, a listing, a block of text or a row of data into a finished, narrated, captioned MP4, rendered from templates written as code rather than generated footage. It is built for video that repeats: property, vehicle and marketplace listing videos, product videos and ad variants, explainers from help articles and release notes, and YouTube videos and Shorts made from a website's pages. Videngine is coming soon, with plans from $79 a month.

## Key facts

- What it does: reads a source (a URL, plain text or markdown, a CSV or a JSON payload), writes a script, builds scenes from coded templates with the brand's type, colours and logo, records a synthetic voiceover or uses uploaded audio, transcribes captions from the finished track and renders MP4 files.
- Formats: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 and 4:5, up to 1080p; captions burned in, as an .srt file, or as a WebVTT track for the web.
- What it is not: not an AI video generator (it does not invent footage; AI writes the script and voice, the pictures come from the source) and not a timeline editor.
- Review: a studio where each video is reviewed before it goes out; batch runs turn one row, or one page from the site's sitemap, into one video. Rebuilds are kept as new versions beside the original.
- Delivery: MP4 downloads, delivery to a Google Drive folder the client owns, publishing approved videos to a connected YouTube channel with a title, description, hashtags and tags written for the Short and the landscape cut, or publishing into the client's own website.
- Website publishing: a workspace connects the GitHub repository its static site is built from (Connect with GitHub, or a fine-grained token). Publishing an approved video makes one commit that adds the MP4, a poster image and a WebVTT caption track, writes an HTML5 player, a readable transcript and VideoObject JSON-LD into the page the video was made from, and keeps video-sitemap.xml and the robots.txt Sitemap line up to date. Everything is in the server-rendered HTML. Framework-built sites are not supported yet.
- Voice: a house voice by default, other synthetic voices per brand, or uploaded audio; a per-brand pronunciation lexicon; the Scale plan adds a cloned voice made only with the speaker's written consent. Narration is in English only.
- Who it is for: businesses with many things worth a video. Workspaces are set up for vehicles and equipment, boats and marine, property, products and e-commerce, software and apps, media and publishing, or services.
- Pricing (launch pricing, US dollars): Starter $79 a month for 50 videos; Growth $249 a month for 250; Scale $599 a month for 750; Custom from 1,500 videos a month. Extra videos cost $1.50, $1.00 and $0.80. A video is one finished render up to 2 minutes; re-rendering the same video in the same month is free. Seats and brands are included in each plan.
- Status: coming soon. Choosing a plan joins the launch list; there is no charge today.
- Built with: Remotion, ffmpeg, headless Chrome, ElevenLabs and Whisper.

## Product

- [Videngine: turn a URL into a finished video](https://videngine.io): Videngine is a programmatic video engine. Give it a link, a product page or a row of data and get back a rendered, narrated, captioned video. No editor.
- [Pricing: plans from $79 a month](https://videngine.io/pricing): Videngine pricing. Four plans priced by finished video, from $79 a month for 50 videos. Team seats and brands included, re-renders free, no per-minute maths.
